01 — About

About Lasting Legacy Cleaners

We specialize in professional headstone and memorial restoration services — designed to respectfully restore the beauty, dignity, and visibility of memorial markers for families, funeral homes, cemeteries, and memorial parks.

Bronze Marker Restoration

Removes oxidation, restores original bronze luster, contrast, and full lettering legibility on all bronze markers.

Headstone Cleaning

Soft-wash cleaning that lifts years of biological buildup while protecting granite and stone surface integrity.

Oxidation Removal

Specialized treatments that safely restore the original appearance of heavily weathered and oxidized memorials.

Memorial Detailing

Meticulous restoration of engravings, lettering, and decorative elements to full visibility.

Protective Sealing

Industry-grade sealants applied after cleaning to shield memorials from future weathering.

Recurring Care Plans

Personalized annual plans tailored to each memorial — scheduled, consistent, and reliable.

02 — Case Studies

Real Results, Real Memorials

Every restoration is fully documented with before & after photography. Here are results our team has delivered.

01

Dr. Randall H. Bayouth

Bronze Marker Oxidation Removal & Full Refinishing
Anderson Memorial Park, Indiana  ·  Bronze Marker Restoration
 

Challenge

The bronze marker had suffered severe oxidation, causing the engraved name, dates, and decorative rose details to become nearly unreadable. Heavy mineral deposits and surface discoloration obscured the memorial's beauty for visiting family members.

Our Approach

Full bronze refinishing — carefully removing oxidation layer by layer, restoring original contrast, re-highlighting all engraved lettering and decorative elements, and applying a protective sealant.

Results Achieved

  • Full lettering and date legibility restored
  • Original bronze luster and contrast recovered
  • Decorative rose and cross details visible
  • Protective sealant applied for long-term care
  • Before & after photo report delivered to family
Outcome

Memorial fully legible. Decorative details restored. Family reported immediate emotional relief upon seeing the result.

02

Grant Thomas Killough

Infant Memorial — Oxidation Removal & Bronze Surface Restoration
Anderson Memorial Park  ·  April 25, 1997 – May 9, 2000

Challenge

The bronze infant memorial showed heavy surface oxidation across the entire face, obscuring the cherub artwork, family inscription ("We love you up to the sky"), and the dates. Family requested restoration ahead of an anniversary visit.

Our Approach

Full oxidation removal with particular care to protect delicate cherub and floral artwork. Bronze refinishing applied to the entire surface. Protective sealant applied as a final step.

Results Achieved

  • Cherub and floral artwork fully restored
  • Family inscription legible in full
  • Birth and passing dates clearly readable
  • Bronze surface refinished with sealant
  • Completion report with photos delivered
Outcome

Infant memorial fully restored with artwork and inscription legible. Family expressed deep appreciation for the respectful care shown.

Before
03

Albert E. Schwab — Medal of Honor

Veteran Memorial Refinishing — USMC, Okinawa 1945
Anderson Memorial Park  ·  PFC Marine Corps  ·  KIA May 7, 1945
After

Challenge

The memorial site for Medal of Honor recipient PFC Albert E. Schwab — including a large bronze marker and Medal of Honor plaque — showed significant weathering and oxidation. Military insignia and service details were heavily obscured. Family requested restoration ahead of Memorial Day.

Our Approach

Treated with the highest level of care and reverence. Full oxidation removal across both the main marker and Medal of Honor plaque. Military insignia, rank, and dates fully restored. Long-duration protective sealant applied.

Results Achieved

  • Medal of Honor plaque fully restored
  • Military insignia, rank, and service dates legible
  • USMC branch information clearly visible
  • Full bronze refinish on both markers
  • Completed before Memorial Day deadline
  • Funeral home referral partnership confirmed
Outcome

Veteran memorial restored with full honors preserved. Completed on schedule for Memorial Day.

04

Funderburg Family Memorial

Full Bronze Marker Restoration — Family Plot with Vase
Anderson Memorial Park  ·  Moree (1928–2019) & E.J. (1928–1979)
Before
After

Challenge

The Funderburg bronze marker had lost its deep contrast due to prolonged outdoor exposure. Lettering, decorative border, and family name were dulled and difficult to read. The memorial vase also required cleaning and refinishing.

Results Achieved

  • Deep bronze finish fully restored
  • Family name and dates clearly legible
  • Decorative border details restored
  • Vase cleaned and refinished in same visit
  • Family enrolled in Premium Annual Plan
Outcome

Marker fully restored. Family enrolled in recurring annual care plan. Vase included at no additional cost.
